opening.argument: The presentation offers purchasable BitClub mining pools rather than merely discussing mining in the abstract. It displays pools with Buy Now buttons, including a $500 Pool 1 option and a stated 1,000-day mining period. The speaker further describes the purchase as investment in computing power and links accumulated shares to the ability “to allow you to continue mining.” These features present paid participation and ongoing mining as the expected structure of the opportunity. Although the material does not establish that viewers paid or received returns, it promotes a paid mining arrangement whose appeal rests on continued participation and accumulation.
